overview.text: Pedestrian bridge featuring a kite-inspired design, with shops and a relaxation area.

text.text: People say this tourist attraction offers stunning views of the Sabarmati River, especially at night when the bridge is illuminated with colorful LED lights. They highlight the unique kite-inspired design, the refreshing breeze, and the relaxing atmosphere, perfect for a leisurely stroll or photography. They also like the reasonable ticket prices and the availability of food stalls and a flower garden.

overview.text: Educational science complex featuring exhibits, displays and rides.

text.text:
People say this science museum offers a variety of engaging exhibits, including an aquarium, robotics gallery, and planetarium. They also highlight the family-friendly atmosphere, interactive exhibits, and the availability of electric vehicles for transportation.

Other reviews mention some exhibits can be under maintenance.

overview.text: Well featuring intricate carving and stonework, plus a history-rich site for architecture enthusiasts.

text.text: People say this historical landmark features ancient architecture, intricate carvings, and a beautiful garden. They highlight the peaceful and cool atmosphere, and the affordable entry fee. They also like the well-maintained grounds and the availability of restrooms and drinking water.

People say this park offers a beautiful flower garden with a wide variety of flowers, and a scenic view of the Sabarmati River. They highlight the reasonable entry fee, the well-maintained pathways, and the peaceful atmosphere, perfect for relaxation and family outings. They also like the availability of food stalls and the opportunity to enjoy cycling and the Atal Bridge.

overview.text: River promenade featuring lush gardens and parks along the water's edge.

text.text: People say this tourist attraction offers a beautiful riverfront with scenic views, a flower park, and the Atal Bridge. They highlight the peaceful and calm atmosphere, perfect for relaxation, evening walks, and photography. They also like the well-maintained walkways, cycling paths, and boating activities.

Visitors say this airport is clean and well-maintained with a good selection of food and retail options, including franchise outlets and lounges. They also highlight the efficient check-in process, helpful staff, and the overall pleasant travel experience.

Some reviews mention the airport can be crowded.

overview.text: Relaxed setting with boat rides, parks and trails along the scenic Sabarmati River.

text.text: Visitors say this riverfront offers a scenic walking promenade, beautifully landscaped gardens, and a variety of activities, including boating, water sports, and a children's park. They also highlight the clean and vibrant public space, perfect for exercise, and the soothing ambiance, especially at night.

displayName.text: Gulmohar Greens Golf & Country Club Limited

overview.text: Lush 5-star hotel featuring an 18-hole golf course, a spa and a playground.

text.text: People say this golf club offers a well-maintained golf course, spacious rooms and villas, and a variety of recreational activities, including a spa, swimming pool, and sports options. They highlight the peaceful and luxurious ambiance, and the beautiful, expansive green landscapes. They also like the attentive and courteous staff, and the delicious dining options.

overview.text: Venue exhibiting a vast array of vintage cars from the 1800s–1960s, plus motorcycles, horse carts, and other antique vehicles.

text.text:
People say this museum offers a vast collection of vintage cars, including Rolls Royce, Bentley, and Cadillac, showcasing automotive history and craftsmanship. They also highlight the well-maintained vehicles, the peaceful and relaxing atmosphere with peacocks roaming around, and the informative and polite staff.

Other reviews mention the entry fee can be high.

overview.text: Relaxing space along the Sabarmati River featuring a walkway gardens and amusement parks as well as events year-round.

text.text: Visitors say this event venue offers a scenic location along the Sabarmati River, with well-maintained lawns and gardens, and a peaceful atmosphere. They also highlight the excellent facilities, including spacious event halls, modern audio-visual equipment, ample parking, and clean restrooms.

overview.text: Tranquil lake and marshy grassland sanctuary for birds, with species from around the world.

text.text:
Visitors say this park is a peaceful bird sanctuary where you can enjoy the sunrise, watch migratory birds, and take photographs. They also highlight the serene and natural atmosphere, perfect for a relaxing getaway from the city.

Some reviews mention the entry fee can be expensive.
